payload.title: pp2k-ppe-pda
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook is designed to perform climate reconstruction using the `cfr.ReconJob` class. It loads a pseudoPAGES2k database from a netCDF file and calculates climate anomalies against a reference period of 1850-1870 CE. The notebook specifies the use of a Proxy System Model (PSM) and considers seasonality for different proxy types. The primary goal is to set up a reconstruction job and load climate data for analysis.
goals: Create a reconstruction job using the cfr.ReconJob class
Load the pseudoPAGES2k database from a netCDF file
Calculate climate anomalies against a reference period
Specify PSM and seasonality for proxies

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook initializes by creating a reconstruction job object using the `cfr.ReconJob` class. It loads the pseudoPAGES2k database from a netCDF file and calculates climate anomalies against the reference interval 1850-1870 CE. The notebook also specifies the Proxy System Model (PSM) and considers seasonality for each proxy type.
section_blurbs.heading: Notebook start

inputs: Climate data netCDF files for temperature and precipitation
outputs: Reconstruction job object with loaded climate data and anomalies
